_meta.disclaimer: This seed data is for academic demonstration only. It is not medically validated. Do not use for actual medical diagnosis.

diseases.name: Curl Demo Syndrome
diseases.description: curl test
diseases.next_steps: n/a
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract caused by rhinoviruses, adenoviruses, or coronaviruses.
diseases.next_steps: Rest, stay hydrated, use OTC cold remedies. See a doctor if symptoms worsen after 10 days.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Influenza
diseases.description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses (A, B, or C).
diseases.next_steps: Rest, hydrate. Consider antiviral medication within 48 hours of onset. Seek care if breathing difficulty occurs.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: COVID-like Respiratory Illness
diseases.description: A respiratory illness with features similar to COVID-19 including characteristic loss of taste/smell.
diseases.next_steps: Isolate, get tested, monitor oxygen levels. Seek emergency care if breathing is severely impaired.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description: A neurological condition causing intense, debilitating headaches, often with nausea and light sensitivity.
diseases.next_steps: Rest in a dark quiet room. Use prescribed triptans. Track triggers. Seek care if it's the worst headache of your life.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Tension Headache
diseases.description: The most common type of headache, often caused by stress, poor posture, or muscle tension.
diseases.next_steps: OTC pain relievers, rest, stress management, neck stretches. See doctor if frequent (>15 days/month).
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the stomach and intestines, usually caused by viral or bacterial infection.
diseases.next_steps: Oral rehydration, bland diet (BRAT). See doctor if symptoms >3 days, high fever, or blood in stool.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Typhoid Fever
diseases.description: A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella typhi, spread through contaminated food or water.
diseases.next_steps: Requires antibiotics. Hospitalization may be needed. Ensure safe food and water practices.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.description: A mosquito-borne disease caused by Plasmodium parasites, affecting red blood cells.
diseases.next_steps: Seek immediate medical care. Antimalarial drugs required. Do not self-treat.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Dengue Fever
diseases.description: A mosquito-borne viral disease causing high fever and severe body aches (breakbone fever).
diseases.next_steps: Seek immediate medical care. Monitor platelet count. Avoid NSAIDs.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: Infection that inflames air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid or pus.
diseases.next_steps: Seek immediate medical care. Antibiotics or antivirals required. Hospitalization may be needed.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Bronchitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the lining of bronchial tubes, usually viral, sometimes bacterial.
diseases.next_steps: Rest, stay hydrated, humidifier. See doctor if symptoms persist >3 weeks or if high fever develops.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Asthma
diseases.description: A chronic inflammatory disease of the airways causing recurrent episodes of wheezing and breathlessness.
diseases.next_steps: Use prescribed inhaler. Avoid triggers. Seek emergency care if rescue inhaler fails.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Hypertension
diseases.description: Persistently elevated blood pressure in the arteries, often asymptomatic until severe.
diseases.next_steps: Monitor BP regularly. Lifestyle changes (diet, exercise). Take prescribed antihypertensives.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Type 2 Diabetes
diseases.description: A metabolic disease causing high blood sugar due to insulin resistance or insufficient insulin production.
diseases.next_steps: Blood glucose monitoring, dietary changes, exercise, prescribed medication. Regular specialist follow-up.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Anemia
diseases.description: A condition in which the blood lacks enough healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin.
diseases.next_steps: Blood test to determine type. Iron/B12/folate supplements as needed. Treat underlying cause.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Urinary Tract Infection
diseases.description: Bacterial infection in any part of the urinary system — kidneys, ureters, bladder, or urethra.
diseases.next_steps: Antibiotics required. Increase fluid intake. See doctor promptly — untreated UTI can affect kidneys.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: GERD (Acid Reflux)
diseases.description: Gastroesophageal reflux disease — chronic acid reflux damaging the esophageal lining.
diseases.next_steps: Avoid trigger foods, don't lie down after meals. OTC antacids. Prescription PPI medication.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Appendicitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the appendix — a medical emergency requiring surgery.
diseases.next_steps: Seek IMMEDIATE emergency care. Do not eat, drink, or take pain relief that may mask symptoms.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Jaundice
diseases.description: Yellowing of skin and eyes due to elevated bilirubin — indicates liver, bile duct, or blood disorder.
diseases.next_steps: Blood tests to determine cause (hepatitis, gallstones, etc.). Specialist evaluation required.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Chickenpox
diseases.description: A highly contagious viral disease caused by varicella-zoster virus with characteristic itchy blisters.
diseases.next_steps: Isolate, use calamine lotion, antihistamines for itch. Antiviral if high-risk. Avoid scratching.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Allergic Rhinitis
diseases.description: An allergic response to airborne allergens (pollen, dust, pet dander) causing hay fever symptoms.
diseases.next_steps: Antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids, avoid allergens. Allergy testing if chronic.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Sinusitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the sinuses, usually following a cold or allergic rhinitis.
diseases.next_steps: Saline nasal rinse, decongestants. Antibiotics for bacterial sinusitis lasting >10 days.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Tonsillitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the tonsils, typically caused by viral or bacterial (strep) infection.
diseases.next_steps: Rest, warm fluids, OTC pain relievers. Antibiotics for strep. ENT referral for recurrent cases.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
diseases.description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva — the clear membrane covering the white part of the eye.
diseases.next_steps: Good hygiene, avoid touching eyes. Antibiotic drops for bacterial; antihistamine for allergic.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
diseases.description: A chronic autoimmune disorder causing joint inflammation, pain, and deformity.
diseases.next_steps: Rheumatologist referral, DMARDs, physical therapy, regular monitoring.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis
diseases.description: Degenerative joint disease causing cartilage breakdown, most common in knees, hips, and hands.
diseases.next_steps: Weight management, physical therapy, OTC pain relievers. Cortisone injections or surgery for severe cases.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Peptic Ulcer
diseases.description: Open sores in the lining of the stomach or upper small intestine (duodenum).
diseases.next_steps: H. pylori test and treatment. PPIs. Avoid NSAIDs, alcohol, smoking. Endoscopy if severe.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
diseases.description: A chronic functional disorder of the large intestine affecting bowel habits without structural damage.
diseases.next_steps: Low-FODMAP diet, stress management, probiotics, antispasmodics. Rule out IBD.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Hypothyroidism
diseases.description: Underactive thyroid gland producing insufficient thyroid hormone, slowing metabolism.
diseases.next_steps: TSH blood test. Levothyroxine replacement therapy. Regular monitoring.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Hyperthyroidism
diseases.description: Overactive thyroid gland producing excess thyroid hormone, accelerating metabolism.
diseases.next_steps: TSH and thyroid antibody tests. Antithyroid drugs, radioiodine, or surgery depending on severity.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Kidney Stone
diseases.description: Hard mineral and salt deposits that form in the kidneys and cause intense pain during passage.
diseases.next_steps: Seek medical care. IV fluids, pain management. CT scan to assess. Surgery or lithotripsy for large stones.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Acute Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack)
diseases.description: A life-threatening emergency where blood flow to part of the heart muscle is blocked.
diseases.next_steps: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY (112/911). Do not drive yourself. Chew aspirin if available and not contraindicated.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Stroke
diseases.description: Brain cell death due to interrupted blood supply — time-critical emergency (FAST acronym).
diseases.next_steps: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY. Note time symptoms started. Every minute counts.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Meningitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord — medical emergency.
diseases.next_steps: CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY. IV antibiotics must be started within 1 hour.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Hepatitis B
diseases.description: A viral infection attacking the liver, can lead to chronic liver disease and liver cancer.
diseases.next_steps: Antiviral therapy, liver function monitoring, specialist referral. Vaccination for contacts.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
diseases.description: A chronic skin condition causing inflamed, itchy, and cracked skin.
diseases.next_steps: Moisturize frequently, avoid triggers, topical corticosteroids, antihistamines. Dermatologist referral.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Psoriasis
diseases.description: A chronic autoimmune skin disease causing rapid skin cell buildup forming scales and plaques.
diseases.next_steps: Topical treatments, phototherapy, biologics for severe cases. Dermatologist referral.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Anaphylaxis
diseases.description: A severe, potentially life-threatening allergic reaction requiring immediate epinephrine.
diseases.next_steps: USE EPINEPHRINE AUTO-INJECTOR (EpiPen) AND CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES IMMEDIATELY.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Panic Disorder
diseases.description: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with intense physical and psychological symptoms.
diseases.next_steps: CBT therapy, SSRI medication. Learn breathing techniques. Rule out cardiac causes.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Gout
diseases.description: A form of inflammatory arthritis caused by uric acid crystal deposits in joints.
diseases.next_steps: NSAIDs or colchicine for acute attacks. Allopurinol to reduce uric acid. Dietary changes.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Scabies
diseases.description: A contagious skin infestation by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei causing intense itching.
diseases.next_steps: Prescription permethrin or ivermectin. Wash all clothing/bedding. Treat all household contacts.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Peptic Ulcer Disease (Bleeding)
diseases.description: A bleeding peptic ulcer — a gastrointestinal emergency requiring urgent endoscopy.
diseases.next_steps: SEEK EMERGENCY CARE IMMEDIATELY. IV fluids, blood transfusion may be needed. Emergency endoscopy.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Anxiety Disorder
diseases.description: A mental health condition characterized by persistent, excessive anxiety affecting daily life.
diseases.next_steps: CBT therapy, possibly SSRIs. Mindfulness, regular exercise. Avoid excessive caffeine.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Dehydration
diseases.description: Excessive loss of body fluids and electrolytes, potentially dangerous if severe.
diseases.next_steps: Oral rehydration salts. If severe/confused, seek emergency care for IV fluids.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.

diseases.name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
diseases.description: The most common form of anemia, caused by insufficient iron to produce hemoglobin.
diseases.next_steps: Iron supplements, iron-rich diet. Investigate cause of iron loss (GI bleeding, menstruation). Blood test.
diseases.remedies_disclaimer: Traditional suggestions only — not a substitute for medical care.
